verified_facts.text: Scrub Island is 1.5 miles off the coast of Tortola, the largest island in the British Virgin Islands.
verified_facts.excerpt: Scrub Island is just 1.5 miles off the coast of Tortola—the largest island in the BVIs

verified_facts.text: Tortola is home to the Terrance B. Lettsome International Airport (EIS).
verified_facts.excerpt: as well as the Terrance B. Lettsome International Airport (EIS)

verified_facts.text: The resort is set on a secluded private island in the British Virgin Islands.
verified_facts.excerpt: where luxury meets the natural beauty of a secluded private island sanctuary

verified_facts.text: Villas come in 2-, 3-, 4- and 6-bedroom floor plans.
verified_facts.excerpt: Choose from 2-, 3-, 4- and 6-bedroom floor plans

verified_facts.text: The villas are nestled into lush hillsides.

verified_facts.text: Villas have a private plunge pool or an infinity-edge pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Private plunge pool or an infinity-edge pool

verified_facts.text: Villa guests have a dedicated butler service who arranges excursions, island-hopping and private tours.
verified_facts.excerpt: We arrange everything from excursions and island-hopping adventures to private tours and personalized experiences tailored to your preferences.

verified_facts.text: The villa butler is always just a WhatsApp message away.
verified_facts.excerpt: your butler is always just a WhatsApp message away

verified_facts.text: Villa guests can have groceries delivered to the villa through an online provisioning service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Everything will be delivered to your villa, so when you arrive there’s nothing to decide

verified_facts.text: Private chef services can be arranged in the villas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Private chef services can be arranged

verified_facts.text: Suites add a full gourmet kitchen, a spacious living area and a massive balcony.
verified_facts.excerpt: Upgrade to a suite for a full gourmet kitchen, spacious living area and a massive balcony.

verified_facts.text: Ixora Spa is perched high above the Caribbean Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched high above the Caribbean Sea.

verified_facts.text: Ixora Spa uses ELEMIS products.

verified_facts.excerpt: Find your zen in a tranquil yoga session amidst breathtaking ocean views on the terrace at Ixora Spa.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center in Marina Village is open 24 hours a day.
verified_facts.excerpt: Open 24 hours a day for your convenience.

verified_facts.text: The resort's marina offers 55 deep-water slips, including five for mega-yachts up to 160 feet.
verified_facts.excerpt: Scrub Island’s marina offers 55 deep-water slips for short- or long-term docking, including five specifically for larger mega-yachts up to 160 feet in length.

verified_facts.text: Scrub Island Marina is the closest marina to the North Drop, a hot spot for world-record billfish.
verified_facts.excerpt: Scrub Island Marina is the closest to the North Drop, the hot spot for world-record billfish.

verified_facts.text: Full- or half-day fishing excursions can be booked with boat, guide and equipment.
verified_facts.excerpt: Book full- or half-day fishing excursions complete with boat, guide and equipment.

verified_facts.excerpt: Our marina is also the departure point for most of the water-oriented activities at Scrub Island.
